_comment: Ratchet for scripts/ci/raw-status-leak-guard.mjs (UX-003). maxViolations is the live count measured on the fix/ux-003 branch after fixing procurement/planning/new, hr/payroll/CreatePayrollRunForm, citizen/grievances/new, and procurement/indents/new/CreateIndentForm (down from 172 pre-fix). It must only ever move DOWN, in the same PR that fixes the corresponding files — see follow-up gap UX-016 in docs/ENTERPRISE-GAP-REPORT-2026-09-07.md for the tracked remainder. UX-016 tranche 1 (fix/ux-016) fixed the entire works/ module (17 violations across 10 files: works/_data/client.ts, works/approvals/ApprovalFinalizeButton.tsx, works/billing/[workId]/BillingActions.tsx, works/billing/account-compile/page.tsx, works/contractors/[id]/ContractorEditToggle.tsx, works/execution/[workId]/ExecutionActions.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalActions.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalEditToggle.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalExtActions.tsx, works/tenders/[id]/TenderActions.tsx), lowering the count from 169 to 152. 152 remain across the other modules — re-run the guard for the current file:line list before starting the next tranche. UX-020 EXCEPTION to 'only ever moves down': 152 -> 261 on fix/ux-020 is a detection-strength jump, not a regression or a bulk-unfix — independent review of UX-016's own 'done' works/ module found 6 real leaks the pre-UX-020 regex structurally could not see (un-parenthesized `${res.status}` template interpolation, `String(res.status)`, and hardcoded '<Verb> failed' fallbacks other than the one literal 'Request failed' phrase the guard checked for). Strengthening the regex to close those holes (see raw-status-leak-guard.mjs's doc comment) made 109 more pre-existing, already-live violations visible fleet-wide (152 -> 261) without a single new leak landing — confirmed by diffing the file:line list before/after the regex change, not just the count. UX-020's OTHER fix (browserClient.ts's errorMessageFromResponse, see the gap report) incidentally fixed its own `API_ERROR: ${res.status}` fallback as part of routing through toHumanError, which happened to also be one of the 261 the strengthened regex could now see (apps/web/src/lib/api/browserClient.ts:56) — a real, verified fix, so 261 -> 260 the normal way this ratchet always moves down: re-ran the guard after the browserClient.ts change and confirmed the count dropped by exactly that one file:line, nothing else. 260 remain (259 from the detection-jump set, un-fixed; UX-020 does not fix the 6 named works/ sites either — proving detection was the DoD, see the gap report). UX-024 (filed, still Open) separately found the 260 checked-in here was ALREADY 1 low vs the live count (261) at that same commit — one pre-existing, unrelated leak in apps/web/src/lib/crm/documents.ts:271 dating to PR #463, outside both UX-016's and UX-020's scope; tracked and fixed independently, not folded in here. UX-016 tranche 2 (fix/ux-016-tranche2) fixed the entire hr/ module — the single largest concentration per a fresh guard run (50 of the then-live 261 violations across 39 files: hr/_components/{OvertimeClaimForm,WFHRequestForm}.tsx, hr/advances/RequestAdvanceForm.tsx, hr/apar/new/page.tsx, hr/appraisals/new/NewAppraisalForm.tsx, hr/attendance/regularisation/RegularisationTable.tsx, hr/confirmation/_components/ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx, hr/dashboard/_components/ActionInbox.tsx, hr/departments/DepartmentsTable.tsx, hr/departments/new/AddDepartmentForm.tsx, hr/designations/DesignationsTable.tsx, hr/designations/new/AddDesignationForm.tsx, hr/employees/[id]/edit/EditEmployeeForm.tsx, hr/employees/import/ImportForm.tsx, hr/employees/new/AddEmployeeWizard.tsx, hr/holidays/AddHolidayForm.tsx, hr/leave-policies/{CreateLeavePolicyForm.tsx,page.tsx}, hr/leave/allocate/AllocateLeaveForm.tsx, hr/leave/apply/ApplyLeaveForm.tsx, hr/leave/approvals/LeaveApprovalsPanel.tsx, hr/leave/history/page.tsx, hr/locations/new/AddLocationForm.tsx, hr/overtime/new/page.tsx, hr/payroll/[id]/PayrollRunActions.tsx, hr/payroll/disbursement/{BankFileForm,BankFileWizard,DscConfigForm,NachMandateForm}.tsx, hr/payroll/pensioners/new/CreatePensionerForm.tsx, hr/payroll/returns/{ForceFileButton.tsx,page.tsx}, hr/payroll/tax-declaration/TaxDeclarationForm.tsx, hr/recruitment/[id]/{page.tsx,applications/[appId]/page.tsx}, hr/recruitment/new/NewJobOpeningForm.tsx, hr/training/new/NewTrainingForm.tsx, hr/transfer/_components/TransferOrderCard.tsx, hr/travel/TravelRequestForm.tsx), each routed through useFormError's fromResponse/fromException (server components hr/payroll/returns/page.tsx used the non-hook toHumanError building block directly, same as works/_data/client.ts in tranche 1) with inline fieldError(...) spans added on every addressable field. Guard confirms 0 remaining under hr/; live count 261 -> 211 (exact match, strict reduction; the pre-existing UX-024 documents.ts drift is untouched and still embedded in 211, tracked separately). 211 violations remain across ~29 other modules — re-run the guard for the current file:line list before the next tranche.
